global.name: CrewCommon
global.description: Sees what every crew member sees: the sectors, the ship classes, the pilots and their certifications.

global.name: Headquarters
global.description: Runs the fleet from headquarters: manages clients, ships, pilots and sectors, the crew's and the clients' accounts and seats, and issues bulletins.

global.name: SalvageDesk
global.description: Works the salvage desk: browses the client list.

List.condition: insured IS NULL OR insured = true

global.name: CommandStaff
global.description: Views the application as another user and assumes any role, for support and demonstrations.

global.name: Adjutant
global.description: Records commendations and reads the ones on file.

global.name: FeatureAdministrator
global.description: Turns feature flags on and off for an environment.

global.name: Surveyor
global.description: Charts new sectors and corrects their records.

domain.name: SectorMarshal
domain.description: Runs a sector: seats its crew, declares its directories, and commands its missions, ships, refits and consignments.

domain.name: SectorCrew
domain.description: Sees a sector's wings and hangars.

domain.name: Cadet
domain.description: Flies as a cadet: sees the sector's missions and squadrons, claims a mission, and files a distress call.

domain.name: Pilot
domain.description: Flies for a sector: sees its missions, ships and squadrons, claims a mission, and hails a ship.

List.condition: hazard <= subject.clearance AND (requiredCert IS NULL OR requiredCert IN subject.certifications)

Read.condition: hazard <= subject.clearance AND (requiredCert IS NULL OR requiredCert IN subject.certifications)

Execute.condition: hazard <= subject.clearance AND (requiredCert IS NULL OR requiredCert IN subject.certifications)

domain.name: Veteran
domain.description: Sees a sector's missions and squadrons.

domain.name: FlightLead
domain.description: Leads flights: plans sorties and their expenses, and launches, holds, resumes, completes or fails a mission.

List.condition: assignedSquadron IN subject.squadrons OR bookedBy = subject

Read.condition: assignedSquadron IN subject.squadrons OR bookedBy = subject

domain.name: Dispatcher
domain.description: Dispatches a sector's missions: keeps the mission board, attaches documents, compiles briefings, and holds a mission. Sees who holds which role in the sector's own crew.

Update.condition: state IN ('open', 'claimed') AND new.assignedSquadron IN subject.squadrons
state NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'stood_down') AND new.deadline >= deadline

domain.name: Overseer
domain.description: Oversees a sector's missions and squadrons and amends a mission's record.

List.condition: deadline < now AND state NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'stood_down')

Read.condition: deadline < now AND state NOT IN ('completed', 'failed', 'stood_down')

domain.name: BookingAgent
domain.description: Books missions for clients: creates, amends, cancels and stands down a mission.

domain.name: WingCommander
domain.description: Commands a wing: sees the sector's missions and squadrons, and rates the pilots who fly for the sector alone.

domain.name: Engineer
domain.description: Keeps the ships flying: inspects a ship, runs its refit and flight tests, and hails it.

domain.name: Quartermaster
domain.description: Keeps the sortie expenses: records, amends and removes them.

domain.name: Supercargo
domain.description: Handles consignments: records them and releases them for delivery.

domain.name: Archivist
domain.description: Keeps the sector's record: reads missions, sorties, expenses and the ship's log, and compiles briefings.

domain.name: Assessor
domain.description: Assesses missions from the list.

domain.name: HazardAnalyst
domain.description: Watches the sector's hazard board and the ships in it.

domain.name: Dockmaster
domain.description: Watches the dock: the ships and their refits.

domain.name: NightWatch
domain.description: Stands the night watch over the dock and ticks off refit tasks.

Update.condition: dayOfWeek(now, local) NOT IN ('sat', 'sun') AND state = 'in_refit'

domain.name: Harbormaster
domain.description: Sees the ships in the sector's harbor.

domain.name: DroidIngest
domain.description: The droids' account: ingests their reports and releases consignments.

domain.name: Paymaster
domain.description: Settles a mission's pay.

domain.name: Purser
domain.description: Reads the expense manifests.

domain.name: Registrar
domain.description: Keeps the mission documents: amends, replaces and removes them.

domain.name: Photographer
domain.description: Photographs refit work and attaches the pictures to the tasks.
